{
    "content": "<p>Recently updated a site I maintain that uses the great\n<a href=\"http://www.cmsmadesimple.org/\">CMS Made Simple</a> and had to\nreconfigure SSL (https) for the administrative areas of the site. I've done this\npreviously, but had forgotten exactly what I did.</p>\n<!--more-->\n<p>Here's all it takes:</p>\n<ol>\n<li>\n<p>Get an SSL certificate configured on your domain. You can find instructions for that somewhere else.</p>\n</li>\n<li>\n<p>Modify the config.php file in the base directory. Find the line that's setting up the &quot;root_url&quot; variable. Replace it with the following, replacing <hostname> with your site's host name:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-php\">$config['root_url'] = 'http://&lt;hostname&gt;';\nif(isset($_SERVER['HTTPS']) &amp;&amp; $_SERVER['HTTPS']=='on') {\n    $config['root_url'] = 'https://&lt;hostname&gt;';\n}\n</code></pre>\n</li>\n<li>\n<p>Create an .htaccess file and place it in the admin directory (or whatever you've renamed it to). This file should contain the following:</p>\n<pre><code># force all access to /admin to SSL protected page\nRewriteEngine On\nRewriteCond %{HTTPS} off\nRewriteRule (.*) https://%{HTTP_HOST}%{REQUEST_URI}\n</code></pre>\n</li>\n</ol>\n<p>Done! Your admin directory should now require HTTPS. This works as of CMS Made\nSimple version 1.11.11.</p>\n",

        "rawInput": "\nRecently updated a site I maintain that uses the great\n<a href=\"http://www.cmsmadesimple.org/\">CMS Made Simple</a> and had to\nreconfigure SSL (https) for the administrative areas of the site. Create an .htaccess file and place it in the admin directory (or whatever you've renamed it to). This file should contain the following:\n\n    ```\n    # force all access to /admin to SSL protected page\n    RewriteEngine On\n    RewriteCond %{HTTPS} off\n    RewriteRule (.*) https://%{HTTP_HOST}%{REQUEST_URI}\n    ```\n\nDone! Your admin directory should now require HTTPS. This works as of CMS Made\nSimple version 1.11.11.\n",
